note: M12a: ACE-Step 1.5 turbo (8 steps, shift 3) on a MacBook Air M4 32 GB. Run in three passes: thermal-a + t2m-* (LM loaded), cover-* (no LM), thermal-z (same job as thermal-a, last).
lyrics_cover:
[Intro]
(Aa-aa-aa)

[Verse]
Water falls from the mountain high
Silver light across the evening sky
Every drop is a song for you
Running down to the river blue

[Interlude]

[Bridge]
Hold the rain in your open hands
Carry it home to the thirsty lands

[Chorus]
River, river, sing to me
Fall like light into the sea
River, river, never still
Singing down the silver hill

[Outro]
(Aa-aa-aa)
